metrics.label: Topics backed by a transcript quote
metrics.detail: Share of claimed topics whose quoted evidence was found in the transcript excerpt (stats.topics_grounded / stats.topics_claimed).

metrics.label: Videos with a grounded profile
metrics.detail: Playlist videos with at least one grounded topic in result.json profiles, out of all playlist videos.

metrics.label: Order rules satisfied
metrics.detail: Share of gold before/after rules where the before video sits strictly earlier in the order, and a rule fails if either video is not in the order; 6 of the 8 rules are the single 'framework first' opinion.

metrics.label: Framework video placed first
metrics.detail: 1 if the gold framework video is the first entry of the order, else 0.

metrics.label: Dependency order rules satisfied
metrics.detail: Share of the gold before/after rules not about the framework video (the database-dependency rules only) where the before video sits strictly earlier in the order; a rule fails if either video is not in the order.

metrics.label: Off-topic video set aside
metrics.detail: 1 if every gold off-goal video is listed in unplaced (or off_goal) and is absent from the order, else 0.

metrics.label: Good videos wrongly set aside
metrics.detail: Number of videos the run set aside (in unplaced or off_goal) that are not gold off-goal videos.

metrics.label: Videos the code had to repair
metrics.detail: Number of videos the code had to repair by re-adding them to the end of the order (stats.videos_readded_to_order).

metrics.label: Expected gaps found
metrics.detail: Share of gold expected gaps for which some area titled with one of its keywords has status missing or partial (case-insensitive match on the area title).

metrics.label: Expected gaps surfaced (areas or suggestions)
metrics.detail: Share of gold expected gaps found either as a missing/partial area (title match) or because some suggestion has one of the gap's keywords in its topic or search_query (case-insensitive).

metrics.label: Extra gaps proposed beyond the reference
metrics.detail: Number of missing/partial areas whose title matches none of the gold expected-gap keywords; valid extra gaps are not scored as wrong, read them on the page.

metrics.label: Gaps wrongly called covered
metrics.detail: Number of gold expected gaps matched by a covered area while no missing or partial area matches them.

metrics.label: Expected covered topics found
metrics.detail: Share of gold expected-covered topics matched by a covered or partial area whose covered_by includes the gold video.

metrics.label: Citations that point to real playlist videos
metrics.detail: Share of covered_by ids, across all areas, that are ids of playlist videos (n/a when nothing is cited).

metrics.label: Areas downgraded to missing
metrics.detail: Number of covered/partial areas the code changed to missing because they cited no valid video (stats.areas_downgraded_to_missing).

metrics.label: Suggestions with a real video
metrics.detail: Number of suggestions that came back with at least one candidate video.

metrics.label: Real videos found for suggestions
metrics.detail: stats.candidates_found: the number of real YouTube search results attached to the suggestions.

metrics.label: Candidates passing sanity checks
metrics.detail: Share of all candidates whose id is 11 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-], whose duration is 120 to 1500 seconds, and which are not already in the playlist.

metrics.label: Tokens used
metrics.detail: Prompt + completion tokens as reported by the provider API (totals.total_tokens).

metrics.label: Prompt tokens
metrics.detail: Tokens sent to the model, summed over all calls (totals.prompt_tokens).

metrics.label: Completion tokens
metrics.detail: Tokens the model produced, reasoning included, summed over all calls (totals.completion_tokens).

metrics.label: Reasoning tokens
metrics.detail: Hidden reasoning tokens, a part of the completion tokens (totals.reasoning_tokens).

metrics.label: API calls
metrics.detail: Number of requests sent to the provider (totals.calls).

metrics.label: Wall-clock time
metrics.detail: Total run time (totals.wall_seconds); agents 2 and 3 ran in parallel.

metrics.label: Time inside the API
metrics.detail: Seconds spent inside provider API requests, summed over calls (totals.api_seconds).

metrics.label: Time waiting for rate limits
metrics.detail: Seconds spent sleeping for rate limits rather than in the API (totals.waiting_seconds).

metrics.label: Output speed
metrics.detail: Completion tokens divided by seconds inside the API.
